title: Two-factor authentication
description: Add a code from an authenticator app as a second layer at sign-in, alongside your password.

status.title: Status
status.enabledBody: A code from your authenticator app is required at every sign-in, alongside your password.
status.disabledBody: Not enabled yet. Once enabled, sign-in requires a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password.
status.recoveryCodesLow: Recovery codes are running low. Generate new ones before the last one is used.

enroll.scanStepBody: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy.

disable.dialogBody: Enter a current code to turn off two-factor authentication on this account.

regenerate.dialogBody: The old recovery codes stop working once this is done. Enter a current code to continue.

recoveryCodes.dialogBody: Each code works once and is shown only now. Save them somewhere safe; they let you sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.copyFailed: Codes could not be copied automatically, copy them manually

login.otpBody: This account uses two-factor authentication. Enter a code from your authenticator app or one of your recovery codes.
